sentences.text: 3. As per allegation in the FIR, petitioners along with other accused persons are involved in setting of different competitive examination by using unfair and illegal means.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioners have falsely implicated in this case.

He next submits that nothing has been recovered from their conscious possession of the petitioners which could correlate them to this case and nobody has complaint against the petitioners in respect of cheating.
Petitioners have got clean antecedent and they are in custody since 02.11.2023 and 03.10.2023 respectively.

He next submits that similarly situated co-accused, namely, Sonu Kumar @

sentences.text: 5. Learned APP for the State opposes the prayer for bail of the petitioners.

6. On perusal of the first information report, case diary, seizure list as well as impugned order dated 06.12.2023 and 08.01.2024, it appears that FIR registered against eight named accused persons including the petitioners and other unknown persons on the basis of written report of Police Sub Inspector, Alok Kumar and both the petitioners were arrested in the coaching premises of SRM IT Solution and several Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.4141 of 2024(5) dt.08-10-2024 incriminating materials were seized from the locker of said SRM IT Solution.
Considering the period of custody of the petitioners which is of about one year also considering the other materials available on record, I am inclined to grant bail to the petitioners.

7. Accordingly, let the above named petitioners be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (ten thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned CJM, Patna Sadar in connection with Patrakar Nagar P.S. Case No. 765 of 2023.

(Ramesh Chand Malviya, J) Brajesh Kumar/-
